profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Aspect Build
profile.summary:
At Moov, our team delivered robust distributed, event-driven backend solutions in Go. With a Bachelor's in Computer Science from the University of Wyoming, my educational foundation and commitment to excellence underpins my professional journey. 

My tenure at Language I/O was marked by crafting scalable architectures, user interfaces that delighted customers, and teams of self-directed, skilled, and results-focused engineers. Motivated by continuous learning, I aim to solve meaningful problems through efficient, elegant, and secure software design.

At BillGO, our team transformed a multi-cloud software ecosystem (AWS and Azure). We did this by improving observability and telemetry, adding a more robust, secure and user-friendly CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions, and collaborating closely with multiple siloed engineering teams to implement an incident response process that works both for the engineering teams and the business interests. I was lucky to work closely with the cloud infrastructure team, as well, where I gained valuable experience managing cloud resources via Terraform. I was heavily involved with the company-wide design review process, too, where I learned to discern what makes a great cloud-based service (hint: it heavily depends on the current skills, tools, and patterns).

My expertise lies in backend infrastructure, API design, team-building, and systems architecture. I have experience building front-end applications in React for websites and CRM plugins (mostly within Zendesk). I am also 7+ years into my journey with Agile SCRUM.

My personal interests include: community-building, personal development, mental/emotional/physical fitness, playing and writing music, education, and reading whatever I can get my hands on.
